changelog: Dev build v834. Fixes the self-test PACKAGED_ABI probe: it now resolves CSM's own packaged classes through the plugin classloader instead of the host app loader, which had made packaged_component_abi fail and every feature report a false ABI_MISSING. Adds the active self-test campaign: it enables every CSM setting (each restored afterwards), invokes every mounted CSM control, opens every CSM settings layout in the host NavController and restarts CloudStream once, resuming from a persisted journal. This dev build aggregates all current unpublished source in the shared CSM tree and is not an isolated patch.
message: Dev build v834 - self-test probe loader fix + active campaign
